content.comment_body: Hello, Could someone help? I am searching for HMI software that can communicate with a [product_name] PLC, preferably available as a trial before purchasing a full license. Thanks in advance.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is searching for trial HMI software compatible with a [product_name] PLC, aiming to test it before buying. No built-in trial for [company_name] HMI software is suggested; instead, another user points out Teslascada 2 as a third-party option, highlighting a possible lack of easily found native trial offerings from [company_name].
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to locate HMI software with reliable integration for a [product_name] PLC, prioritizing solutions that offer a trial version—ideally from [company_name].
